# OCS LLC (OCS Window Cleaning)

> Owner-operated window cleaning company based in Kalispell, Montana, serving homes and businesses across the Flathead Valley. Rated 5.0 stars on Google.

- Owner: Barrett Teeney
- Phone / text: (406) 607-2151
- Email: barrett@ocsllc.services
- Hours: 9:30am to 7pm, 7 days a week
- Service area: Kalispell, Whitefish, Columbia Falls, Bigfork, Lakeside, Somers, Evergreen, Eureka and the rest of the Flathead Valley, Montana
- Estimates: instant online estimate at https://ocsllc.services/estimate/ ; firm price confirmed before any work

## Services
- [Residential window cleaning](https://ocsllc.services/services/residential/): glass cleaned by hand inside and out, frames wiped; screens on request
- [Commercial and storefront window cleaning](https://ocsllc.services/services/commercial/): one-time cleans and recurring routes
- [Post-construction window cleaning](https://ocsllc.services/services/post-construction/): construction dust, paint and sticker residue
- [Additional services](https://ocsllc.services/services/additional/): screens, tracks, skylights, chandeliers, solar panels
- Hard water stain treatment, quoted after an inspection
- Cleaning plans (twice a year, quarterly, monthly) with savings after the first clean
